result.rationale: Verified in the diff: topic.rb removes the `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present?` guard from `expandable_first_post?`, and the spec moves the `before` block (which set embed_truncate = true) into the 'with an emeddable host' describe. The remaining test 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' now runs against a topic with no settings applied, so it passes only because embed_truncate defaults to false — nothing about embeddable hosts is actually asserted. This is an accurate, specific test-coverage/meaningfulness concern (the test name misrepresents what is tested), not a production defect.
